method: Measured landmarks, corrected wrist/paw depths and fitted tail cross-sections; continuous chain weights, three mesh-edge smoothing passes, four influences maximum. Distal hand/toe clipping, 0.00001-unit source welding and simple boundary-loop caps; 28 extra digit joints with independent rigid geometry. Accepted pose-space elbow morphs from constrained edge-length fitting; original weights and rest surface unchanged. Character-specific, not automatic anatomical inference.

poseCorrections.method: Pose-space corrective morphs from projected edge-length fitting; original weights, joints and rest geometry preserved.
limits: Only accepted axis-aligned elbow probes; not arbitrary combined poses.
No collision, volume or final design approval.
Disabled after changes to skin weights or bind skeleton.
No morph correspondence between the two independently reconstructed meshes.
Articulated paws replace distal source surfaces; no final design or collision approval.
Landmark skinning and surface refinement require visual review; source reconstruction defects can remain.
